controls.label: Demand input
controls.meaning: Where the time-varying load demand is obtained.
controls.choices: Generate synthetic load | Import prepared GoiEner case folder

controls.label: Load Path
controls.meaning: Folder containing a prepared load history and associated metadata.
controls.default: Placeholder: Choose a GoiEner distributed dataset folder

controls.label: Load source clock (IANA/UTC)
controls.meaning: Time zone / clock used by the imported load dataset.

controls.label: Synthetic-load seed
controls.meaning: Random seed for creating synthetic demand instead of historical data.

controls.label: Frequency
controls.meaning: Network frequency supplied for calculations where required.

controls.label: Network Path
controls.meaning: File path for electrical bus, line, load and PV network workbook.
controls.default: Placeholder: Choose an electrical network workbook (.xlsx)

controls.label: Workbook format
controls.meaning: Which supported workbook format the loader should interpret.

controls.label: Calendar months
controls.meaning: Number of calendar months for date-defined preparation.

controls.label: Start (source clock)
controls.meaning: Starting date when preparing a synthetic/date-defined study.

controls.label: Fallback source
controls.meaning: Pick NASA POWER, a local weather file or prepared PV-power data.
controls.choices: NASA POWER - automatic history | NASA POWER - irradiance CSV | Prepared irradiance CSV | Historical modeled PV power CSV

controls.label: No PV study
controls.meaning: Run a scenario with no solar generation.

controls.label: Pv Source Path
controls.meaning: Location of solar/irradiance history file.
controls.default: Placeholder: Choose a NASA POWER hourly irradiance CSV

controls.label: Use fallback solar source
controls.meaning: Use an alternate solar source if the input case lacks PV history.

controls.label: Latitude (°)
controls.meaning: Latitude of solar-data site.

controls.label: Longitude (°)
controls.meaning: Longitude of solar-data site.

controls.label: Reference (kW)
controls.meaning: Rated total capacity used for the common solar reference.
controls.default: Placeholder: Defaults to total installed PV kW

controls.label: Solar file clock
controls.meaning: Clock used by the solar data source.
controls.default: Placeholder: e.g. UTC — use the source file’s clock

controls.label: Critical irradiance
controls.meaning: Irradiance threshold used by the chosen PV conversion model.

controls.label: Pv Installations
controls.meaning: PV installation bus and rated kW per entry.

controls.label: Standard Irradiance
controls.meaning: Reference irradiance used for converting weather to PV power.

controls.label: Charge efficiency
controls.meaning: Fraction of electrical charging energy stored.

controls.label: Discharge efficiency
controls.meaning: Efficiency delivering stored energy to the network.

controls.label: Initial SOC
controls.meaning: Battery state of charge at the beginning.

controls.label: Maximum SOC
controls.meaning: Largest allowed battery state of charge.

controls.label: Minimum SOC
controls.meaning: Smallest allowed battery state of charge.

controls.label: Policy
controls.meaning: Which battery charging/discharging strategy is used.

controls.label: Equal terminal SOC for technical runs
controls.page: Battery / Equal terminal SOC for technical runs
controls.meaning: Whether battery end SOC must match start SOC for technical runs.

controls.label: Tolerance (%)
controls.page: Battery / Equal terminal SOC for technical runs
controls.meaning: Allowed difference between starting and ending SOC.

controls.label: Energy capacity
controls.meaning: Energy storage capacity for manual BESS.

controls.label: Installation bus
controls.meaning: Installation bus for manually selected BESS.

controls.label: Manual BESS
controls.meaning: Enable a user-specified battery instead of optimizer-selected design.

controls.label: Power rating
controls.meaning: Maximum power rating for manual BESS.

controls.label: Currency
controls.meaning: Currency label for economic results.

controls.label: Additional site CAPEX (USD)
controls.meaning: Extra fixed installation cost per battery project.

controls.label: Annual economics
controls.meaning: Enable the annual economic evaluation model.

controls.label: Annual terminal energy
controls.meaning: Rule used to account for battery energy remaining at year end.
controls.choices: Return to initial SOC | Price terminal energy difference

controls.label: Curtailment (USD/kWh)
controls.meaning: Modeled financial penalty per curtailed PV kWh.

controls.label: Discount rate (%)
controls.meaning: Financial interest/discount assumption for annualizing upfront investment.

controls.label: Energy CAPEX (USD/kWh)
controls.meaning: Battery energy capacity purchase cost per kWh.

controls.label: Explicit prices
controls.meaning: Require acknowledgement that even zero prices were intentionally specified.

controls.label: Export credit (USD/kWh)
controls.meaning: Credit received for grid energy exported.

controls.label: Import price (USD/kWh)
controls.meaning: Price paid per unit of grid energy imported.

controls.label: Lifetime (years)
controls.meaning: Number of years used to annualize battery investment.

controls.label: O&M (% of CAPEX)
controls.meaning: Annual maintenance cost as percentage of battery investment.

controls.label: Power CAPEX (USD/kW)
controls.meaning: Battery power-system purchase cost per kW.

controls.label: Replacement price (USD/kWh)
controls.meaning: Assumed price of replacing a deficit in end-of-year stored energy.

controls.label: Unserved load (USD/kWh)
controls.meaning: Modeled value of lost load per unserved kWh.

controls.label: Allow PV curtailment
controls.meaning: Permit reducing PV output when needed for network constraints.

controls.label: Allow load shedding
controls.meaning: Permit withholding load service when needed for constraints.

controls.label: Show advanced shedding settings
controls.meaning: Toggle visibility of expert shedding controls.

controls.label: Hold BESS Reserve
controls.meaning: Hold battery power/energy back for reserve rather than ordinary dispatch.

controls.label: Reserve duration
controls.meaning: Length of time the reserved power should be available.

controls.label: Reserve power
controls.meaning: Reserve amount defined as percent of feeder peak load.

controls.label: Export cap
controls.meaning: Maximum upstream export power.

controls.label: Limit Grid Export
controls.meaning: Enforce maximum power exported to upstream grid.

controls.label: Import cap
controls.meaning: Maximum upstream import power.

controls.label: Limit Grid Import
controls.meaning: Enforce maximum power drawn from upstream grid.

controls.label: Policy
controls.meaning: How load-shedding controller allocates demand reductions.

controls.label: Final tier weight
controls.meaning: Relative discouragement for near-total shedding.

controls.label: First tier ends at (%)
controls.meaning: Upper shedding fraction for first penalty tier.

controls.label: First tier weight
controls.meaning: Relative discouragement for low shedding amounts.

controls.label: Second tier ends at (%)
controls.meaning: Upper shedding fraction for second penalty tier.

controls.label: Second tier weight
controls.meaning: Relative discouragement for medium shedding amounts.

controls.label: Maximum voltage
controls.meaning: Upper acceptable per-unit bus voltage after controls.

controls.label: Minimum voltage
controls.meaning: Lower acceptable per-unit bus voltage after controls.

controls.label: Show advanced search settings
controls.meaning: Toggle visibility of expert optimization parameters.

controls.label: Energy step
controls.meaning: Discrete increment between permitted BESS energy ratings.

controls.label: Maximum energy
controls.meaning: Largest allowed BESS energy capacity.

controls.label: Maximum power
controls.meaning: Largest allowed BESS rated power in optimizer.

controls.label: Minimum energy
controls.meaning: Smallest allowed BESS energy capacity.

controls.label: Minimum power
controls.meaning: Smallest allowed BESS rated power in optimizer.

controls.label: Power step
controls.meaning: Discrete increment between permitted BESS power ratings.

controls.label: CPU workers
controls.meaning: Number of parallel worker processes used during optimization.

controls.label: Allowed Buses
controls.meaning: Which non-slack buses can host the optimized battery.

controls.label: Annual finalists (0 = preset default)
controls.meaning: Number of shortlisted batteries evaluated for full-year feasibility.

controls.label: Exploration sites (preset default at −1)
controls.meaning: Count of extra sites retained for exploration.

controls.label: Screened sites (0 = preset default)
controls.meaning: Count of promising BESS sites shortlisted from baseline.

controls.label: Crossover
controls.meaning: Probability of crossover in genetic algorithm.

controls.label: Generations
controls.meaning: Number of genetic algorithm generations.

controls.label: Iterations
controls.meaning: Maximum GWO generations.

controls.label: Method
controls.meaning: Select optimization algorithm (GWO / GA).

controls.label: Mutation
controls.meaning: Probability of mutation in genetic algorithm.

controls.label: Population
controls.meaning: Number of individuals in genetic algorithm.

controls.label: Population
controls.meaning: Number of wolves evaluated per GWO generation.

controls.label: Random seed
controls.meaning: Random seed for repeatable GWO search.

controls.label: Preset
controls.meaning: Choose quick/standard/thorough optimizer workload.

controls.label: From
controls.meaning: Start of custom historical technical simulation.

controls.label: Interval preset
controls.meaning: Choose standard or custom simulation time interval.
controls.choices: First 24 hours | 7 days | 30 days | Full calendar year | Full source | Custom

controls.label: Source
controls.meaning: Choose historical or forecast demand/PV as simulation inputs.

controls.label: Until (exclusive)
controls.meaning: End of custom historical technical simulation, exclusive.

controls.label: Forecast origin
controls.meaning: Time the forecast begins.

controls.label: Horizon (hours)
controls.meaning: Hours into the future to generate predictions.

controls.label: Horizon preset
controls.meaning: Choose standard forecast length or custom length.

controls.label: Model
controls.meaning: Choose available forecasting method.

controls.label: Training end (inclusive)
controls.meaning: Final timestamp used for model training.

controls.label: Training start
controls.meaning: First timestamp used for model training.

controls.label: Bus details
controls.meaning: Show details of the selected bus or branch

controls.label: Hide diagram
controls.meaning: Hide the network diagram

controls.label: Properties
controls.meaning: Display network parameters on the diagram

controls.label: Results
controls.meaning: Overlay power-flow results on the diagram

controls.label: Case
controls.meaning: Select one prepared case if the selected parent folder has multiple cases.
controls.default: Dynamic list of available case folders

controls.label: Display one calculated hour
controls.meaning: Inspect one previously simulated time step.

controls.label: Battery series
controls.meaning: Choose battery state of charge or battery power.

controls.label: Bus ID
controls.meaning: Filter diagnostic events by bus ID.

controls.label: Cause
controls.meaning: Filter events by recorded reason code.

controls.label: Show
controls.meaning: Exceptional events or all saved hours.

controls.label: Study date
controls.meaning: Filter event log to a day.

controls.label: Bus
controls.meaning: Filter evaluated batteries by candidate bus.

controls.label: Feasibility
controls.meaning: Filter feasible or infeasible candidates.

controls.label: Filter size by
controls.meaning: Choose power or energy for numerical size filtering.

controls.label: Horizontal axis
controls.meaning: Select horizontal dimension in candidate scatter plot.

controls.label: Max
controls.meaning: Maximum candidate power or energy.

controls.label: Min
controls.meaning: Minimum candidate power or energy.

controls.label: Sort by
controls.meaning: Candidate order: cost, bus, ratings, feasibility.

controls.label: Additional bus/branch series
controls.meaning: Select up to six entity traces in the same graph.

controls.label: Bus / Branch
controls.meaning: Select a particular network entity for an entity-specific graph.

controls.label: Compare with
controls.meaning: Overlay data from a different result scenario.

controls.label: End date
controls.meaning: Last chart day when custom range selected.

controls.label: Metric
controls.meaning: Choose which recorded quantity to plot.

controls.label: Resolution
controls.meaning: Hourly / daily / weekly / monthly aggregation.

controls.label: Start date
controls.meaning: First chart day when custom range selected.

controls.label: Time range
controls.meaning: Full, week, month or custom chart period.

controls.label: Visible scenario series
controls.meaning: Choose which compared run appears on the graph.

controls.label: Alternative
controls.meaning: Compare the baseline and stored-BESS scenarios.

controls.label: Import saved runs
controls.meaning: Add saved HTML, JSON, or ZIP result files for comparison.

controls.label: Run
controls.meaning: Select among imported result runs.

controls.label: Comparison alternative
controls.meaning: Inspect another run alongside the current one.

controls.label: Equipment
controls.meaning: Choose one bus or branch for inspection.

controls.label: Overlay
controls.meaning: Choose voltage, served load, shedding, PV/BESS or violations.

controls.label: Study hour
controls.meaning: Select the hourly network operating point.
